immutable_trigger.receipt_ordering_defect: A later memory-measurement refusal prevented the already successful in-process transcription from becoming durable evidence.

properties: Every reached stage writes one exclusive atomic fsync-backed terminal receipt immediately.
No later stage may replace amend delete invalidate or void an earlier receipt.
Receipts contain hashes and bounded metadata but no audio transcript text raw logs credentials secrets or patient data.
Missing malformed duplicated unknown or out-of-order receipts fail closed.

transcription.stored_content: response transcript readiness and source hashes only; no transcript text

gpu_memory.exercise: loaded v0 model plus a second synthetic inference after the transcription receipt is durable
gpu_memory.scope_limit: This measures serving-inference memory; it does not retroactively claim a startup-memory trace for 003C-C.

predeploy_sampler_self_test.transport: AWS Systems Manager Run Command using AWS-RunShellScript
predeploy_sampler_self_test.target: the exact EC2 instance backing the stable DRA GPU node
predeploy_sampler_self_test.duration: 120 numeric samples at approximately one-second intervals
predeploy_sampler_self_test.execution_context: crictl exec into the exact DRA gpus container then /busybox/chroot /driver-root /usr/bin/nvidia-smi
predeploy_sampler_self_test.required_output: one bounded numeric MEDZEN_SAMPLER_SELF_TEST_V1 PASS line

live_iam_gap.conclusion: The required SSM self-test cannot run until the EKS node role receives SSM Agent core permissions.

iam_design.shared_role_effect: The existing CPU and GPU node groups share this role, so both become SSM managed nodes after credential refresh.

No sender permissions data sink permissions or application permissions are introduced.
